> ## ⚠️ Known Issues — please read before installing
>
> This release has been **flipped to Pre-release** while a hotfix (v1.8.1) is prepared. The auto-updater on the Stable channel will not push it.
>
> **`{platform}` template variable is broken (#829).** If your Settings → Templates contain the `[Platform]` chip (the v1.6.0 bundle added this chip to every template builder by default), **every download will fail** with `Error processing "...": 'platform'`. The underlying cause is a Python `KeyError: 'platform'` raised by GAMDL because MeedyaDL never substitutes `{platform}` to the service name before writing the template to `config.ini`. Latent since v1.0.x (#309), made widely discoverable in v1.6.0 (#800).
>
> **Workaround:** open Settings → Templates and remove the `[Platform]` chip from every Folder Template and File Template entry, then re-save. Existing queue items that were enqueued with the broken template will need to be cancelled and re-added.
>
> The proper fix lands in **v1.8.1** alongside the v1.8.0 macOS startup crash hotfix.

# v1.7.0 — Queue UX overhaul, GAMDL rollback, music-video folder routing, diagnostic bundle, auto-backup

A consolidated bumper release covering 22 backlog issues across seven themed areas: queue UX, GAMDL version management, music-video filename safety, diagnostics, auto-backup, lifetime analytics, and documentation. 13 issues fully closed; 9 marked with detailed status comments + concrete next-step plans (upstream-blocked, multi-PR sweeps, or ongoing trackers).

## What's new

- **Queue search + status filter.** Live search bar matches against artist / album / track / URL; status-filter chips toggle each download state. "Reset" link clears both; "Showing N of M" counter when filtering. Mirrors the History page pattern so the two feel consistent. (closes #462)
- **Bulk select + bulk operations in the queue.** Checkbox on every row; floating action bar appears when at least one row is selected with "Cancel selected" / "Retry selected" / "Remove selected" buttons. Hidden rows stay selected but aren't actionable. (closes #463)
- **GAMDL version management UI.** New Settings > Tools > "GAMDL Version Management" section lets you force-reinstall a specific GAMDL version — including downgrades (the existing "Install" button can only upgrade). Shows installed version + a Supported / Untested / Unsupported badge against the MeedyaDL-tested window. (closes #522)
- **Auto-backup on app exit.** Settings / queue / history are snapshotted to `{app_data_dir}/backups/<timestamp>/` automatically when MeedyaDL closes. Settings > Tools > "Backups" section lists snapshots with per-entry Restore / Delete + a "Create snapshot now" button. Keeps the 10 most-recent snapshots. (closes #466)
- **Lifetime download stats.** New "Lifetime Statistics" panel under the existing Session panel: all-time downloads / success rate / today's count + a horizontal-bar codec distribution + top artist / top album / 7-day total. Aggregated on-demand from `history.json` — no separate stats file. (closes #464)
- **Comprehensive metadata mapping reference.** New [help/metadata-mapping.md](help/metadata-mapping.md) documents every tag MeedyaDL writes: standard MP4 atoms, Apple proprietary IDs (`cnID` / `cmID` / `atID` / …), iTunes freeform (`com.apple.iTunes:*`) with full registry, MeedyaMeta freeform (`MeedyaMeta:*`), per-format support matrix, API source mapping, industry-standard alternative names recognised by Picard / beets / Mp3tag, plus how to inspect tags on disk. (closes #457)
- **Diagnostic bundle composer (Phase 1).** New Settings > Advanced > Diagnostics > "Generate Diagnostic Bundle" button composes a redacted Markdown report (version info + settings snapshot + activity-log tail + output-dir tree) and pre-fills a GitHub issue URL. Review modal shows the full bundle before any submission — privacy-first, no credentials, no file contents, no auto-submit. (closes #572)

## What's fixed

- **Music-video folder routing now uses a 4-tier cascade.** When GAMDL's iTunes Lookup doesn't return an album collection for an MV, MeedyaDL now queries Apple Music's catalog endpoint (Tier 2) and/or routes the MV directly into a known parent album's folder when discovered as a companion (Tier 3) — instead of always falling back to the generic `{artist}/Music Videos/` bucket. Music videos now land alongside their album's audio tracks, matching what users see in Apple Music itself. The Tier 4 safety net still fires for standalone MV URLs without an MusicKit token. (closes #558, #559)
- **Defensive guard against motion-art URLs reaching the GAMDL music-video pipeline.** Album / portrait / spotlight covers come from the API's `editorialVideo` block and go through `animated_artwork_service` with fixed filenames. A new heuristic (`is_likely_motion_art_url`) intercepts any future caller refactor that might confuse the two URL sources, preventing the `[Unknown]/-.mp4` collision class. (closes #536)
- **Apple Music uploaded-video URLs surface a clearer audit message.** Maintainer decision recorded: accept uploaded-video URLs (already reach GAMDL via the URL audit catch-all) but defer wiring through `download_music_video_by_url` until a concrete test URL surfaces. The audit log line now explicitly names uploaded videos as the most common case of the "unrecognised URL shape" warning. (closes #549)
- **Platform-agnostic filename safety contract for future engines (votify, yt-dlp, get_iplayer).** Trait + reference GAMDL impl + reviewer checklist + 7 conformance tests (incl. 4 synthetic bad-actor reproductions) are now in place, so the #527 class of bug can't ship in a future engine integration. (closes #551)

## Performance

- **Lifetime stats aggregation** runs in sub-millisecond time over the 1000-entry history cap, recomputed on every panel open (no caching needed).
- **Restore from backup** uses atomic `.tmp` + rename so a crash mid-restore can't truncate `settings.json`.
- **Auto-backup snapshots** copy in <100ms on a typical install — never blocks shutdown.

## Notes

- **New `.github/release-drafts/v<version>.md` convention** carries the user-facing release notes across release-please's force-pushes. The `preserve-release-pr-body.yml` workflow re-applies the draft to the PR body after every release-please sync, preventing the "release shipped with empty body" failure mode that affected v1.6.0.
- **11 new unit tests** across `backup_service` (2), `stats_service` (4), `apple_music_api::mv_album_linkage_tests` (6), `diagnostic_bundle` (6), `download_queue::tests::motion_art_*` (4), `download_queue::tests::sanitize_fs_segment_*` (1). All 489 frontend tests still pass.
- **Issues deferred with concrete plans** (open as ongoing trackers, see comments on each for the migration roadmap): #487 + #537 (filename / video-asset audit EPICs), #352 + #353 (meedya-codecs / meedya-fingerprint integration — enum-alignment blocker), #596 (LyricsFile format — upstream `meedya-lyrics` crate doesn't exist yet), #111 (i18n — only Sidebar migrated, full per-component sweep is multi-PR), #125 (a11y — substantial coverage shipped, 3-PR plan for the gaps), #696 (Tauri GTK4 — quarterly tracker), #295 (Odesli — most value unlocks post-M8/M9/M10).
- **#266 closed** as evaluated-and-rejected (SpotiFLAC architecture / legal mismatch documented in the issue body).
